meta.purpose: Extracted NSQF-aligned Qualification Pack (QP-NOS) dataset for SIH 2026 PS#97 skill-gap and recommendation knowledge base
meta.source: NSDC master QP-NOS course list (notification dated 4 June 2018), fetched from kaushalya.mahaswayam.gov.in public mirror; cross-checked against current NCVET NSQF structure (10 levels, revised 6 June 2023)
meta.coverage: 546 Qualification Packs across 16 Sector Skill Councils, extracted from the first ~29 of 56 pages of the source document (entries roughly Sr.No. 1-1044; remaining pages of the source cover additional sectors such as IT-ITeS, Healthcare, Retail, Media, Telecom, Textiles, Plumbing, Logistics, Tourism & Hospitality, Power, Mining, Rubber, Life Sciences, Leather, Paints & Coatings, Sports, Security, Media & Entertainment, and others not included here)
meta.disclaimer: This is a prototype/demo dataset for hackathon use, algorithmically extracted from a public 2018-notification course master list. NSQF levels for some QPs may have been revised since; verify against live NCVET/NSDC/Skill India records before any production use, and never present this as a complete or currently authoritative source in front of judges without this caveat.

field_definitions.sr_no: Original serial number in the source master list (kept for traceability, not sequential after fixes)
field_definitions.job_role: NSQF-aligned job role / Qualification Pack title
field_definitions.entry_qualification: Minimum stated entry qualification for the QP
field_definitions.cost_category: Common Norms cost category (1-3) used for government funding rate calculation, not relevant to skill-matching
field_definitions.self_employment: Heuristically flagged true if the role commonly supports self-employment/micro-enterprise based on job title patterns (farmer, artisan, tailor, entrepreneur, etc.) - verify manually for demo-critical roles
field_definitions.informal_skill_keywords: Auto-extracted keywords from the job role title, for prototype keyword/embedding-based skill matching - refine manually per role for production use
